entities.name: Assassin's Blade
entities.description: Novel by Scott McGough, first book of the second Legends cycle, published December 2002.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: The imperial champion of the Madaran Empire, a thorn in Overdark's side.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: The imperial assassin ordered to quell the Edemi uprising, who wants Tetsuo to die.

entities.name: Nekoru Wasitora
entities.description: A Nekoru who made the village of Sekana her home and becomes champion's deputy.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Tetsuo's healer, infected by Xira Arien's brood.

entities.name: Tor Wauki the Younger
entities.description: Tetsuo's second and featured character of the novel.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Tetsuo's armorer and Kei's teacher.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: An assassin who lures Tetsuo to the Edemis and infects Kei with her brood.

entities.name: Lady Orca
entities.description: A monstrous giantess sent by Overdark to attack Kusho.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: General of the Kentsu who promises not to interfere without the emperor's order.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Second in command of the Kentsu, made Overdark's unwitting minion.

entities.name: Gosta Dirk
entities.description: A defender of Kusho.

entities.name: Kasimir the Lone Wolf
entities.description: A defender of Kusho.

entities.name: Lord Magnus
entities.description: Ruler of the forest on the southern half of Argenti.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: The ruler of Argenti.

entities.name: Madaran Empire
entities.description: The empire served by the imperial champion and assassin.

entities.name: Edemi Islands
entities.description: Islands that rebelled against the Madaran Empire.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Military force led by Marhault Elsdragon.

entities.name: Sekana
entities.description: Village where Wasitora lives.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Island where Tetsuo's group is met by defenders.

entities.name: Argenti
entities.description: Island ruled by Lady Caleria.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: Plane Tetsuo walks while unconscious and where he kills the insect inside Kei.

entities.name: Serpent Generator
entities.description: An artifact Xira hid for Overdark that produces an endless flow of snakes.

entities.name: Emperor
entities.description: Ruler of the Madaran Empire, furious at Overdark's failure.

entities.name: Elder Land Wurm
entities.description: A wurm from Argenti who announces the Edemi declaration of war.

events.summary: The Edemi Islands rebel and the emperor orders Overdark to quell the uprising; Overdark hopes Tetsuo will die in the conflict.
events.quote: The emperor orders his imperial assassin Ramses Overdark to quell the uprising.

events.summary: The village council calls in Tetsuo to defeat Wasitora; their duel is interrupted by an Elder Land Wurm, whom they defeat together.
events.quote: Wasitora and Tetsuo defeat the wurm.

events.summary: Overdark sends Lady Orca to attack Kusho in Umezawa's crest and orders Xira Arien to lure Tetsuo to the Edemis.
events.quote: orders the assassin Xira Arien to lure Tetsuo to the Edemis.

events.summary: Tetsuo rewards Wasitora with the position of champion's deputy and she accepts.
Xira Arien attacks Kei and infects him with her brood.
events.quote: he is attacked by Arien, who infects him with her brood.

events.summary: Kei has a vision of Lady Orca murdering Kusho; Tetsuo realizes it is a trap but travels to Kusho with Tor and Ayesha.
events.quote: Tetsuo realizes it is a trap of Lord Overdark's creation but has to journey to Kusho to protect his honor

events.summary: Overdark meets Elsdragon, who says the Kentsu will not interfere unless the emperor orders it.
events.quote: Elsdragon replies that he will not interfere unless told to do so by the emperor.

events.summary: Jorgan Hage ambushes Overdark for revenge, but Overdark subdues him and infuses him with black mana, making him a minion.
events.quote: Overdark easily subdues him, however, and infuses Hage with black mana, making him the assassin's minion without his knowledge.

events.summary: Tetsuo's group defeats Kusho's defenders and discovers Arien was never there and Orca has left for Argenti.
events.quote: The defenders are defeated, and Tetsuo discovers Arien was never on Kusho

events.summary: On Argenti the group defeats Lord Magnus, who leads them to Lady Caleria; Caleria has all the imperials arrested while Xira flees.
events.quote: Caleria reveals she isn't that gullible, however, and has all the imperials arrested.

events.summary: Overdark summons Lady Orca again; she attacks Caleria's castle and is defeated by Tetsuo, who is left drained.
events.quote: The giantess attacks Lady Caleria's castle but is defeated by Tetsuo.

events.summary: Tetsuo breaks out of prison, frees Tor and challenges Caleria to a duel as Overdark activates the Serpent Generator.
events.quote: Then Overdark activates the artifact Xira hid for him- a Serpent Generator .

events.summary: Caleria is defeated in the duel and lets the group leave; Tetsuo and Ayesha kill the insect inside Kei, halting his mutation.
events.quote: Tetsuo and Ayesha engage the insect inside Kei on the Meditation plane and kill it.

events.summary: Xira Arien fights Tor and Ayesha, is seriously wounded and plummets into the sea.
events.quote: she is seriously wounded and plummets into the sea.

events.summary: The emperor, furious at Overdark's failure, gives the task of culling the rebellion to Elsdragon and Hage.
events.quote: The emperor is furious about the assassin's failure.

relations.quote: The emperor orders his imperial assassin Ramses Overdark to quell the uprising.
